title: Removed  skipIfTorchDynamo from test_set_default_dtype_works_with_foreach unit test
body:
Fixes #116028

Removed skips for test_set_default_dtype_works_with_foreach Dynamo test. Most of the test already pass due to past updates. Made a small change in the _multi_tensor_adafactor() function so that the only failing test (test_set_default_dtype_works_with_foreach_Adafactor_cuda_float64) passes as well.
